title: RUSSELL COIGHT
tickerText:
G'DAY!  WELCOME TO RUSSELL COIGHT'S ALL AUSSIE ADVENTURES! GRAB YOUR AKUBRA, PACK YOUR ESKY AND PREPARE TO EXPLORE THE GREAT AUSTRALIAN OUTBACK WITH A MAN WHO KNOWS ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING ABOUT SURVIVAL. UNFORTUNATELY, MOST OF IT IS WRONG!

PLAYED TO PERFECTION BY COMEDY LEGEND GLENN ROBBINS, RUSSELL COIGHT IS AUSTRALIA'S MOST CONFIDENTLY INCOMPETENT BUSHMAN.

SINCE FIRST HITTING OUR SCREENS IN 2001, THIS CULT COMEDY CLASSIC HAS DELIVERED COLLAPSING TENTS, RUNAWAY FOUR-WHEEL DRIVES, DISASTROUS CAMPFIRES, QUESTIONABLE WILDLIFE ADVICE AND SOME OF THE MOST AWKWARD HANDSHAKES IN TELEVISION HISTORY.

WHETHER HE'S TRACKING WILDLIFE, HELPING AN OLD MATE OR EXPLAINING THE DANGERS OF THE BUSH, RUSSELL'S UNWAVERING CONFIDENCE IS MATCHED ONLY BY HIS ABILITY TO MAKE A COMPLETE MESS OF EVERYTHING.

WITH THREE HILARIOUS SERIES AND A CELEBRITY CHALLENGE SPECIAL, ALL AUSSIE ADVENTURES REMAINS A MUCH-LOVED AUSTRALIAN COMEDY CLASSIC.

SO FIRE UP THE LANDCRUISER, WATCH OUT FOR THE WILDLIFE AND REMEMBER, WHEN RUSSELL COIGHT'S IN CHARGE, WHAT COULD POSSIBLY GO WRONG?

LET'S GET CRACKING ON ANOTHER ALL AUSSIE ADVENTURE!
